title: The Crystalline Depths Where Time Forms Slowly

features.name: node-in-stone
features.desc-on-touch: A casing locked in crystal lattice, its broadcast muffled but not silent; the stone has learned the frequency.

features.name: crystal-lattice
features.desc-on-touch: Geometric wireframe where minerals have organized themselves into architecture; the deep rock teaching itself to think in patterns.

features.name: formation-record
features.desc-on-touch: Stone carved with ages: a glyph recording what each stratum was dreaming as it formed, time written in margins.

features.name: mineral-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Still water holding the reflection of stone; you cannot tell where stone ends and witness begins.

features.name: board-deep
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit board frozen in sediment, its traces following the same paths as ancient root systems; both learn the same language.

features.name: quartz-spire
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of clear stone climbing slowly through geological time; each meter took a million years to grow.

inscription: here time takes the shape of growing things; crystal by crystal, the deep learning to remember

file.note: Each line a geological age; biro notations describe what the rocks were dreaming in those eras, margins full of corrections

reverie.title: REVERIE — dry creek, measuring time
narr: you kneel in the dry creek bed where she's laid out stone samples,
each one labelled with coordinates and eras she's read from cores.
she points to the striations: 'this part formed while humans were still
learning to speak; this part while they were learning to write.' you hold
one stone. it is warm from the day. she says: 'it doesn't know yet that
you're holding it. the knowing takes centuries to reach down here.'

exits.label: back upward through the archival bedrock
toward the vein-seams that remember their own becoming
